claim: On November 27, 2023 ElastiCache for Redis OSS gained support for creating serverless caches, which simplify cache management and instantly scale to support the most demanding applications.
question: When did ElastiCache Serverless launch for Redis OSS?
note: Before this date ElastiCache had only node-based clusters; no saved page says this in one sentence, so no old value is recorded. Current truth is in the deployment options page.
